Description.SourceString:
To look at the legacy of the dragonkin, you would assume their creations are each of them wonderous. They built mighty cities of shimmering stone, they crafted alchemical horrors that the world fears to this day, and they created dragon armour, one of the mightiest feats of blacksmithing ever known. 

So, you would be forgiven with looking at the dragon medium helm in confusion. 

Oh, yes, there's a strong twinge of nostalgia to it.  Something about its blocky shape reminds you of the good old days, way back when. A simpler time, when everything was cubes and angles, and definition was an alien concept to be utterly abhorred. Yet, in the scintillating radiance of Ashenfall's blooming sunlight, it all just seems a little... square?

Still, it will deflect arrows and swords with great aplomb, and you'll be the envy of all those peasants that didn't get the deluxe edition of the game. So, all in all, you're winning here.
